summary.what: A fixed VLM describes individual executed ego–target interactions. Each clip is rendered in a fixed world view (blue ego E, orange target T1, gray other vehicles, drivable-area mask) and given to the VLM together with code-computed measurements (box-overlap intervals, visible-frame counts, max adjacent-frame displacement). The VLM returns a label (reasonable / clearly anomalous / insufficient evidence) and a one-line reason naming time and vehicle; reasons are then checked against the supplied numbers. It is a traceable description alongside trajectory measurements, not an independent evaluator.
summary.model: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct (revision 0cfaf48183f594c31), BF16, greedy decoding, max 512 new tokens; one MP4 per clip at 10 Hz (100 frames nuScenes, 70 nuPlan)
summary.prompt_gist: Fixed Chinese instruction (SHA-256 prefix 42bcf582): two-line output, label + reason with time and vehicle. "Clearly anomalous" requires a locatable spatiotemporal contradiction; a never-visible target requires "insufficient evidence"; collision alone is not an anomaly; no judging displacement against unsupplied thresholds; no mechanism-match or responsibility judgment. Method names withheld; signals, right of way, lane direction, off-road and post-contact dynamics listed as unavailable.

headline_stats.text: 12 illustrative cases (3 nuScenes, 9 nuPlan; five planners; four map regions); 10 with target contact
36-case extension, family counts 8/8/8/2/4/6, 28 nuPlan / 8 nuScenes, 5 with target contact; 48 rollouts in total with 15 contacts
18 of 36 extension reasons (50%) invoke a physical or normal range without a supplied threshold (an explanation-error count, not a rate of physically invalid trajectories)
Controls: injected jump flagged as clearly anomalous at 0.7–0.8 s (supplied displacement 11.9 m); never-rendered target labelled insufficient evidence; continuous clip labelled reasonable

summary.caveats: No independent human accuracy labels and no video-only/metadata-only comparisons. Measurements are VLM inputs, so a matching explanation shows consistency with supplied information, not independent recovery from video. Labels carry no accuracy or physical-validity interpretation (sec/appendix_vlm.tex lines 8, 19, 24).
summary.language_note: Raw outputs are Chinese; vlm_excerpt_zh is verbatim from responses.jsonl, vlm_excerpt_en_paper is the paper's abridged English translation.
notes: The VLM saw MP4 videos; only six-frame overview JPGs of the same prepared cases are available locally, so the site images are overviews, not literal model input.

The final paper's per-case notes match data/vlm_classic12_20261110 (system instruction SHA-256 42bcf582…). data/vlm_classic5_20261110 is an earlier run with a different system instruction (28560ef5…) and is not used for excerpts.

Possible inconsistency: tab_vlm_cases.tex line 29 lists the injected-jump control as nuPlan / IDM, but the matching classic12 development response (11.911 m at 0.7–0.8 s) uses coordinates of the nuScenes scene of case a15857bf97086147d959. The extension36 control run reports 11.96 m in nuPlan coordinates. Not used as a showcase case.
trajectory_fact_check.json exists only for the earlier classic5 run; verdicts here use the paper footnotes and classic12 explanation_audit.json.
